args.title: Use PUBLIC_URL env var instead of localhost for password reset email links
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently hardcodes `http://localhost:3000` as the `BASE_URL` when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to localhost, which is unreachable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to rely solely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` for production URLs, removing the fallback to localhost entirely.
